name: secureview
description: SecureView — partage de documents confidentiels en lecture seule, sans fuite du fichier source.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
